streams.notes: ACP session/update stream — the authoritative conversation log (user-guide 17-sessions.md). Envelope {timestamp, method, params}. method is session/update or _x.ai/session/update. Discriminator is params.update.sessionUpdate: user_message_chunk, agent_message_chunk, tool_call, tool_call_update, turn_completed.

Raw model messages. Fixture types: system (string content), user (content[] text blocks; prompt_index on real queries), assistant (string content + optional tool_calls[{id,name,arguments}]), tool_result (tool_call_id + string content). Compaction may rewrite the file.

Turn-scoped timestamps. Fixture types: turn_started, loop_started, phase_changed, first_token, turn_ended, tool_started, tool_completed, permission_requested, permission_resolved. Not listed in 1.0.5 user-guide 17-sessions.md but written by the binary.

Session index: info.id/cwd, session_summary, generated_title, created_at/updated_at/last_active_at, num_messages, num_chat_messages, current_model_id, next_trace_turn, chat_format_version, request_id, grok_home, agent_name, sandbox_profile.
Session counters: turn/user/assistant counts, contextTokensUsed/contextWindowTokens, modelsUsed, primaryModelId, toolFailureCount, latency samples.
One rewind point per user prompt: prompt_index, created_at, file_snapshots, after_snapshots.
Prompt-builder snapshot: version, prompt_mode, audience, working_directory, is_non_interactive, memory_enabled, system_prompt_label.
Rendered system prompt text for the session.
Auto-title generation counter (single integer).
Per-tool-call shell capture (call_<id>.log), referenced from tool_call_update.rawOutput.output_file.
Per-cwd prompt history: timestamp, session_id, prompt, is_bash.
TODO/task list state (`todos` object). Absent from the hermetic farm; present in organic sessions.
User feedback and ratings — not written by the farm scenarios.
Saved compaction state (manual or auto).
Per-subagent metadata (meta.json); child sessions live in the normal sessions tree. Farm disables subagents; organic census observed status/ids/model fields.
Original cwd when the encoded name exceeds 255 bytes (slug+hash fallback). Farm cwds are short.
FTS5 index over session titles and prompts for `grok sessions search`. Harvest includes -wal/-shm.
Main configuration. Farm writes [model.mock-model] chat_completions + [cli]/[features] isolation. Agent may append [marketplace].
TUI appearance configuration — not written in headless farm runs.
Installed-version cache for update checks. Farm sets GROK_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER so this may be absent.
Credentials — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only, excluded from harvests.
Internal structured log (ts/src/pid/lvl/msg/ctx). No `type` discriminator.
Other internal logs (MCP server logs, etc.). unified.jsonl is its own stream.
Install/agent identity marker (UUID text).
Home-dir metadata format version (single integer).
Live session registry; headless farm leaves it empty (`[]`).
Cached model catalog — not written when remote_fetch is off.
Workspace trust records.
Git worktree registry (worktrees.db + WAL). Used by `grok du` / `grok worktree gc`.
Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.
